decision_basis: User objective: discover transformation stories before they become obvious. V11.1 metrics were deliberately not inspected before this redesign.
architecture: Transformation meta-model excludes V10.2 probability entirely.
Transformation meta-model uses catalysts, business inflection, promoter conviction, accumulation, ownership quality, pledge signals, and early-stage/priced-in interactions.
Final score blends 55% independent transformation meta evidence, 35% V10.2 confirmation, and 10% explicit early-stage score, less risk penalty.
Main candidate eligibility is transformation-first. High V10.2 momentum alone cannot qualify a stock.
A moderate V10.2 confirmation is normally required, but exceptionally strong early transformation evidence can bypass it when priced-in penalty is very low.
No weak names are force-filled into the current Top-10.
Early Discovery Radar remains separate for very strong transformation candidates that are still technically early.
Historical acceptance tolerates some loss of V10.2 precision only if the selected names are measurably earlier-stage and drawdown remains controlled.
